After the verb ज्ञ , when used in the sense of 'denying', the आत्मनेपद is used.

Terms: आत्मनेपद

After the verb वद् 'to tell', preceded by अप , when the fruit of the action accrues to the agent, the terminations are of the आत्मनेपद।

Terms: आत्मनेपद

The words अप and परि are कर्म-प्रवचनीय when meaning 'exclusion'.

Terms: कर्मप्रवचनीय-उप

The words अप , परि , बहिल् and indeclinables ending in अञ्चु may optionally be compounded with a word ending in the 5th case affix and the compound so formed will be अव्ययीभाव ।

Terms: समास-अव्ययीभाव

The 3rd case-affix is used after the words denoting the duration of time or place, when the accomplishment of the desired object is meant to be expressed.

Terms: विभक्ति-3
When the अपादान कारक -- ध्रुवमपायेऽपादानम्

, is denoted, the 5th case-affix is used.

Terms: विभक्ति-5

The तत्-पुरुष word अपथम् 'a bad road', is neuter.

Terms: समास-gender

The affix लट् (Present Tense) comes after a verb when the particle स्म is in connection with it and denotes a past action not belonging to the current day and when the action is perceived by the agent.

Terms: लट्

The word अपघन is irregularly formed meaning 'a member of the body'.

Terms: Irregular

The affix णमुल् is added to the root when a noun in the Ablative -5th case is in composition and when 'haste' is intended.

Terms: णमुल्

The affix ङीप् is not used when a तद्धित affix is elided after a द्विगु समास (Numeral Determinative Compound) ending in a word not denoting a mass or measure; or in 1. बिस्त 2. आचित or 3. कम्बल्य।

Terms: विभक्ति-ङीप्

A descendant being a grandson or a still lower offspring is called गोत्र।

Terms: गोत्र

The affix वुञ् comes after the word साल्व in the senses of being born etc. when denoting 'a man 'or 'what exists in a man', provided that it does not mean a foot-soldier.

Terms: वुञ्

The affixes कक् and कन् come respectively after the words 1. अपमित्य and 2. याचित when the sense is that of completion.

Terms: कक् and कन्

The affix तसि comes after that Ablative -5th case which has the force of an अपादान कारक when this अपादान relation arises owing to the union with the verbs हीय (passive of हा) and रुह।

Terms: तसि

In the छन्दस् the following irregular forms are met with - अस्पृधेथाम् , आनृचुः , आनृहुः , चिच्युषे , तित्याज , श्राताः , श्रितम् , आशीः , आशीर्त्तः।

Terms: लिट् लकार-छन्दस्

There is optionally the substitution of आ in the room of the dipthong of the root गुर् 'to exert' when preceded by the preposition अप and taking the affix णमुल्।

Terms: धातु-खिद्-छन्दस्

The augment सुट् is placed before क , when the verb कृ comes after अप and the sense is 'the scraping of earth by four-footed animals or birds'.

Terms: सुट् augment

The word अपस्पराः is formed by the augment सुट् when the sense is that of 'uninterrupted action'.

Terms: सुट् augment

The word अपस्कर is formed by सुट् meaning 'the part of a chariot'.

Terms: सुट् augment

The word मुख has acute accent (उदात्त) on the final after the preposition अप्।

Terms:

The य् of a Patronymic affix, preceded by a consonant, is elided before a तद्धित when it does not begin with an आ।

Terms: य elision

And after अपचित has also a second form with the augment इ ।

Terms: इट् augment

The word अपरिह्वृता is irregularly formed in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

Terms: इट् augment

Up to the end of the पद , is throughout to be supplied the following - 'A cerebral letter substituted always in the room of …, when this letter does not stand at the end of a word'.

Terms: विसर्ग सन्धि
